rationale.consistency: Follows sibling patterns: Apache header, RegisterModule/RegisterHandlerDirective, interface guards, humanize for sizes, defaults beside defaultReadHeaderTimeout. Handler struct uses time.Duration in JSON fields instead of caddy.Duration, unlike the rest of the codebase.
rationale.edge_cases: Hard cap applied, credit overflow clamped, zero-length writes, ErrNotSupported disables further attempts, nesting tightens rather than double-wraps. But MinRate is silently ignored when Timeout<=0 despite applyRead/readOn gating on it, and disable-via-negative is non-obvious.
rationale.scope: Delivers all required pieces; extra nesting API (Restrict, SetDeadline, SetMaxChunk, FindIdleTimeoutWriter) is justified by the per-route handler but widens surface somewhat.
rationale.readability: Clear names, concise comments explaining non-obvious choices (why nesting tightens, why deadlines are cleared). next() is a bit dense but readable.
rationale.robustness: No panics, errors logged at debug. However the deferred SetRead/WriteDeadline(time.Time{}) in Server.ServeHTTP also clears net/http's own hard ReadTimeout/WriteTimeout before post-handler body drain and final flush, weakening existing hard timeouts now that idle is on by default.
rationale.maintainability: Policy logic centralized in IdleDeadline; wrapper mutation for nesting is a bit of hidden coupling; the wrap/defer-clear block is duplicated between server.go and timeouts.go rather than shared.
